whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a package whose `Source` is a code host rather than a repository.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a package whose `Source` is a code host rather than a repository.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm renv.lock no longer carries a package whose `Source` is a code host rather than a repository.
